name: PALS's Notes component kit
summary: Python generators for PALS's Notes scenes (scene-render 1.1/1.2): helpers and components that write inline XML, vendored into each project with a lock file.

requires.brand_kit: palsnotes-brand.xml (passed in by the project; the source of truth for tokens and styles)

extracted_from: v013-jev-decisions (film/lib.py, brand.py, captions.py, shorts.py, emblems.py), byte-identical golden: tests/golden/

components.name: Doc
components.summary: The document under construction: frame size, text-role styles, id set and the registries that become sections (assets, paints, materials, fields, bodies).
rules: one id set per document: every helper's ids are unique

components.name: bind
components.summary: The helpers with a Doc filled in (uid, text_asset, label, draw, rect, disc, group, pill, Cam, Brand) plus the pure ones.

components.name: f / esc / keys / opacity / path_d / hash01 / fmt / Ids
components.summary: Number formatting (3 decimals, no trailing zeros), attribute escaping, unique ids, opacity windows with fades, keyframe <animate>s, polyline path data, a stable hash shared with expressions (HASH_EXPR).
params: opacity(a, b, fin=0.5, fout=0.5, peak=1.0, ease_in=cubic-out, ease_out=cubic-in)

components.name: palette
components.summary: The kit's colour tokens as hex (INK, RAISED, CREAM, MUTED, ORANGE, RULE, COOL); tokens(kit) reads a kit, check(kit) compares.
rules: palsnotes-brand.xml is the source of truth for tokens (guide §14, Brand)

components.name: text_asset
components.summary: A <text> asset registered once per distinct text and look; returns (id, width, height) with an estimated box.
rules: every text sets its colour explicitly (guide §14: a textStyle colour renders white)

components.name: label
components.summary: A text layer anchored center|left|right, fading in and out over [a, b], optional textAnimator preset.
rules: labels >= 36 px at 1080p (guide §5, Typography): smaller sizes are raised to 36

components.name: draw
components.summary: A frame-sized path that draws itself (trimEnd) from a over dur, then stays until b.

components.name: rect / disc / group
components.summary: A centred (or top-left anchored) rect, a circle, a group of items with an optional fade.
params: rect(x, y, w, h, fill, a, b, radius, stroke, sw, anchor)
disc(x, y, r, fill, a, b, stroke)

components.name: pill
components.summary: A fully rounded rect with a centred caps label, one group anchored at its centre (ids pid, pid-b, pid-t).
rules: orange is a fill here, never type on a raised panel (kit contrast note)

components.name: arrow_d / round_rect_d
components.summary: Path data: an arrow with an open head; a rounded rectangle (the emblems' rr).

components.name: Cam
components.summary: A 2D camera group for one act: framing cues keyed to times or beats (through an injected resolver), clamped to safe rectangles, sine-in-out moves that lead their cue, a drift after each cue; verify() samples every 0.25 s.
rules: safe-rect clamp: what must stay in frame is kept 150 x 84 px inside the frame (guide §14, Camera)
widening moves lead, narrowing moves wait for the old content to fade (guide §14)
verify every 0.25 s against the safe rect in force and that of the last 1.2 s; builds report breaches (guide §14)
no shot holds still: drift after each cue unless hold (guide §5, Cinematography)

components.name: prologue
components.summary: The kit's prologue (parameters, styles, layouts, safe areas, font asset, text assets, symbols, accessibility) verbatim, with the episode's parameter defaults.
rules: every episode carries the kit's prologue verbatim, defaults set per episode (guide §14, Brand)

components.name: Brand.title_card
components.summary: Opening title over ink: kicker (pn-label) at 192,300, title (pn-display, balanced, <= 3 lines) rising into 192,360, optional line-drawn emblem, notch.
rules: inline copy, not a symbol instance: <override> is dropped by encode (guide §6, Avoid 1)
composited above the finish (guide §14, Brand)
title card before 20 s (guide §14): timing is the caller's

components.name: Brand.chapter_card
components.summary: Chapter divider over ink: orange number (pn-number) at 192,340, rule at y 520, title (pn-heading, <= 2 lines) at 192,540, optional emblem.
rules: inline copy above the finish (guide §6, §14)

components.name: Brand.lower_third
components.summary: Raised panel with an orange bar at 192,680, 900 x 152: name (pn-heading) and role (pn-label), sliding in from x 160.
rules: clear of the caption band; orange is never type on the raised panel (kit)

components.name: Brand.source_line
components.summary: Citation line (pn-cite, <= 2 lines) at 192,108, top-left inside title safe.
rules: kit sizes: pn-cite 24 px labels a source, it does not inform (guide §5)

components.name: Brand.end_card
components.summary: End card over ink: next-video label at 192,480 and credit lines, drifting up; right two thirds left free for end-screen elements; notch.
rules: inline copy above the finish (guide §14)

components.name: Brand.notch / Brand.ink / Brand.emblem
components.summary: The brand mark (orange right triangle, 64 px, bottom-left), a full-frame ink field, a line-drawn subject that draws on stroke by stroke and drifts.

components.name: split_cues / sidecar
components.summary: Caption cues from [(word, start, end)]: units at sentence ends and pauses > 0.45 s, split into the fewest two-line cues by reading rate, never broken after a weak word or into stubs; the <captions> sidecar track with word timings.
rules: captions <= 2 x 42 characters, <= 17 characters/s (guide §4, §13, §14 QA gates)
split at clause ends (guide §14)

components.name: timed / stats
components.summary: Display windows: each cue shown for at least len/16.5 s, borrowing from the pauses either side, lingering up to 1 s; stats() reports cues over 17 cps and the longest line.
rules: readable at 17 characters/s (guide §5, Duration)

components.name: short_cues
components.summary: A Short's burned active-word cues in output time from film words and segment maps; no cue before the cover lifts.
rules: Shorts burn karaoke/active-word captions (guide §9)
captions <= 2 lines

components.name: shorts.overlay
components.summary: A Short's overlay symbol in output time: cover card for 0.8 s (ink, subject, notch), headline rising into the top band, ink bands and feathers around the fitted picture, hook to the long video for the last 2.6 s. The subject drawing is injected.
rules: the first frame is the cover (thumbnail.md)
nothing essential above y 220 on a cover (thumbnail.md, Shorts grid)

components.name: shorts.span_times / segments / output_xml / build
components.summary: Film spans that start and end in narration pauses, output segments with 0.3 s crossfades, the Short <output> with its burned caption track, and the whole set with the feather paints and the 9:16 fit layout.
rules: Shorts are output segments of the film's document (SREP 13)

components.name: physics.signature / physics.block
components.summary: The <physics> block, pointing at a simulation cache only when the cache was made for this document's rigid bodies and fields.

components.name: vo.speak / vo.hazards / vo.rules / vo.entries / vo.asr_aliases / vo.asr_normalise / vo.lexicon
components.summary: The narration dictionary by language (pnkit/data/vo_lexicon.json: respellings, rules, Whisper aliases, each with its source). speak() applies the respellings; hazards() lists what a TTS engine is likely to misread before synthesis (a period that splits a word, digits, symbols, untested acronyms, over-long sentences); asr_normalise() makes known mis-hearings compare equal in the word-error check.
params: lang: BCP 47 as the projects use it (en, pt-br); a base language falls back (en-us -> en)
rules: abbreviations without periods in the spoken text: AI, not A.I. (guide §12 step 3, observed in v013)
numbers written as words in the spoken text; the screen and captions keep digits (guide §5)
a bad Kokoro reading is fixed by changing the text, never by re-rolling (guide §14)
test a new term with tools/vo_probe.py before adding it

tools.tools/sync.py PROJECT_DIR: vendor pnkit into PROJECT_DIR/film/vendor/pnkit and write film/vendor/pnkit.lock
tools.tools/check_lock.py PROJECT_DIR: verify the vendored copy against its lock
tools.tools/gate.py SCENE [--probe T ...] [--m: validate --deny-warnings, eval at probe times (default 0 s) and once per layout and variant (E05/E06 override/target errors), flash-check state
tools.tools/vo_probe.py LINE|FILE ... [--lang: Kokoro reads each line, Whisper large-v3 hears it back, internal pauses over 0.25 s are listed (run in the voice venv); test a term before adding it to the VO dictionary
